visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and a light blue button-down shirt over a white top is kneeling on a colorful geometric rug. Behind her is a light-colored sofa and a white brick wall. She holds a black smartphone towards the camera while large yellow and white text 'iPhone Air' is displayed at the bottom. (2) The woman rolls backward onto the rug, her legs kicking up into the air in a playful motion. She then sits back up and holds the black phone close to the camera, smiling enthusiastically. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio or well-lit home. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of the phone's side profile, showing its extremely thin design compared to a thin card. The phone is then shown being placed into a black trouser pocket and a small white duck-shaped plush bag. (4) The woman is sitting on the rug, holding the phone up as if taking a selfie. Close-up shots follow, focusing on the large single camera lens on the back of the device. (5) A series of sample photos are shown: a plush seal toy, a portrait of the woman, and a still-life scene with a clock and a plant. (6) Three phones in orange, black, and blue colors are displayed on a wooden surface. The woman's hand points to the black model. (7) The black phone is placed next to a light blue phone for a size and thickness comparison. The woman then holds the phone horizontally, demonstrating video playback. (8) In the final phase, the woman looks directly at the camera, gesturing with her hands. She appears to be answering a question, then suddenly looks flustered, dismisses the topic with a hand wave, and crawls out of the frame toward the bottom left.
